con.hero.lede: Call, email, or fill in the form below — for appointments, a direct phone call is the quickest way.
con.sec.title: Ways to reach us & appointment request
con.card.addr.line: North Baridhara (near Norda Bus Stand), Dhaka
con.card.hours.line: Please call to confirm chamber hours.
con.land.note: If the streets are unfamiliar, look for Norda Bus Stand — the clinic is in North Baridhara, close to the stand. Call us and we will guide you.
form.title: Send an appointment request
form.intro: Share your name and phone number — we will call you back to confirm a time.
form.name: Name
form.errPhone: Please enter a valid phone number.
form.msgPh: Describe your problem in a few lines
form.note: Pressing the button opens your email app with the address and message pre-filled — send it from there. Nothing is stored on this website.
form.privacy: It is best not to send sensitive health details by email — share them during the consultation instead.
con.map.title: How to find the clinic
con.reassure: Don't delay out of embarrassment or fear — the first call is the hardest. We will listen to you with dignity.
